description: Refinery Production (Thousands of US Barrels) is a dataset listed in Bahrain open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a national body, published or maintained by Ministry of Oil and Environment. Through the Bapco Refining refinery in Sitra, the company produces high-quality petroleum products that meet the evolving needs of global markets. Coverage: Bahrain. The portal files it under Oil & Gas. Its keywords are Refinery, Oil & Gas, Barrels. The portal shows 9 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-08-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-gov-bh-portal.
